title: Deeply cooled core of the Phoenix galaxy cluster imaged by ALMA with the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
question: How much thermal gas is cooling to low temperatures in the Phoenix cluster core, probed with an ALMA SZE image combined with Chandra X-ray data independent of the X-ray spectrum

data.sensitivity: 0.025 mJy/beam rms at 5 arcsec resolution (theta < 45 arcsec); 0.0122 mJy/beam 1 sigma at native resolution (12-m + 7-m)

recipe.goal: Fit and subtract compact sources in the uv plane
recipe.method: Fit point-like and Gaussian models to 12-m visibilities at baselines >30 klambda with uvmodelfit, subtract in the uv plane before imaging
key_parameters: Four compact sources detected above 5 sigma
C2 modelled as elliptical Gaussian with major-to-minor axis ratio fixed at 0.05
assumptions: C3 and W modelled as point sources since consistent with the synthesized beam

recipe.goal: Image the SZE decrement with 12-m + 7-m multi-scale CLEAN
recipe.method: Deconvolve the source-subtracted 12-m + 7-m visibilities with Multi-Scale CLEAN in tclean using joint mosaic imaging, multi-frequency synthesis and natural weighting; measure noise on half-split difference maps
key_parameters: Mask radius 42 arcsec, threshold 0.024 mJy, loop gain 0.05

recipe.goal: Extract Chandra X-ray spectra and compare with the SZE
recipe.method: Contour-binned Chandra ACIS-I spectra (S/N 100) fitted with an ICM plus central AGN model in XSPEC; compare X-ray and SZE residual maps and estimate equation-of-state perturbations
key_parameters: Background from off-center region 3-5 arcmin from the central AGN
Five position-dependent free parameters (ICM temperature, metallicity, intrinsic absorber column, ICM and AGN normalisations)
Equation-of-state method of Ueda et al. 2018 with line-of-sight depth l = 100 kpc
assumptions: Collisional ionization equilibrium; Anders & Grevesse 1989 abundances

recipe.goal: Simulate ALMA observations to calibrate missing flux
recipe.method: Generate mock visibilities with simobserve from an X-ray pseudo-pressure model at four spectral windows, add noise, deconvolve as for real data, and fit I_out = c1 I_in + c0
key_parameters: Four spectral windows at 85, 87, 97, 99 GHz with 1.875 GHz bandwidth each
Pointings, array configuration, hour angle, integration time and PWV matched to each execution block
assumptions: Pseudo pressure map normalised to ypeak = 8e-4, described as typical of massive cool core clusters; relativistic correction applied

recipe.goal: Derive the Compton y map and compare the inner pressure profile
recipe.method: Divide ALMA image by c1 = 0.94, subtract mean signal at theta = 42 arcsec, apply relativistic correction with projected X-ray temperature, azimuthally average and compare with generalized NFW pressure profiles of cluster samples
key_parameters: Geometrically spaced bins, innermost 0-4 arcsec, size increasing by a factor 1.1

recipe.goal: Non-parametric deprojection of electron temperature and density
recipe.method: Joint fit of SZE brightness (theta < 40 arcsec) and 0.7-2.0 keV X-ray brightness (theta < 100 arcsec) in spherical shells, varying T and ne per shell, with systematic errors added in quadrature; compared against an X-ray-only projct deprojection
key_parameters: Innermost bin 0-4 arcsec (0 < r < 26.7 kpc), size increasing by a factor 1.3
Systematic errors: ALMA flux calibration 6%, missing flux 0.24 uJy/arcsec^2, Chandra ACIS-I effective area 4%
SZE modelled as incremental brightness relative to the bin at theta = 43.6 arcsec, with missing-flux factor 0.94 and temperature-dependent relativistic correction
assumptions: Temperature at r > 250 kpc fixed at 15.8 keV from the X-ray spectral analysis
Metal abundance 0.35 Solar in SPEX emissivity
Innermost-bin intrinsic NH either 6.7e21 cm^-2 or 0

recipe.goal: Derive entropy, cooling time and cool gas mass
recipe.method: Compute K = kT ne^-2/3 and radiative cooling time from the deprojected profiles using SPEX emissivity; integrate gas mass at ~3 keV within r = 27 kpc and divide by mass deposition rates
key_parameters: Comparison entropy slopes K ~ r^1.2 (non-radiative) and K ~ r^1.4 (steady-state cooling flow)
assumptions: Mass deposition rate ~2000 Msun/yr (X-ray) and star formation rate 500 Msun/yr used to compute accumulation times
